swarm.name: The Hand Press
swarm.blurb: A swarm of paper, type and machinery following a plea for help. It preserves what it finds by enclosing it.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Fiber Mite
creatures.blurb: It pulls loose threads for sample cards.

creatures.name: Circuit Gnat
creatures.blurb: It bridges paper circuits and interrupts tools.

creatures.name: Coil Cutter
creatures.blurb: It springs from scrap to seize moving tools.

creatures.name: Layer Weaver
creatures.blurb: It shields damaged machines with paper strips.

creatures.name: Dye Sprayer
creatures.blurb: Its dye marks targets for harvesters.

creatures.name: Cardboard Hand
creatures.blurb: It folds spare board into more grasping hands.

creatures.name: Specimen Probe
creatures.blurb: It tests a movement, then repeats it with a needle.

creatures.name: Bark Beater
creatures.blurb: It pounds bark and anything else within reach.

creatures.name: Garden Harvester
creatures.blurb: It guards its feed hose before charging the next bed.

creatures.name: Embossing Warden
creatures.blurb: It guards the mould and crushes shields against its plate.

creatures.name: Paper Ringmaster
creatures.blurb: It sends silhouettes ahead to protect outgoing sheets.

creatures.name: Total Collection
creatures.blurb: The mill repairs its workers and guards the mould that puts an open hand in every sheet.

creatures.name: Garden Tender
creatures.blurb: A gardener binds wounds with clean fiber.

creatures.name: Weaving Rig
creatures.blurb: The teaching rig winds spare strips into protective wraps.

events.title: Loose sample
events.text: A sample thread leads into a locked cabinet. The frame can be sold, or its clean fiber used for bandages.

options.label: Take the frame
options.result: The crew salvages the frame for 35 gold.

events.title: Moving day
events.text: Gardeners offer a medical roll or emergency cash for help moving seedlings. They need the other for the next bed.

events.title: A useful grip
events.text: A half-built hand grips a wedge. The box holds a repair kit. There is time to take one before the hand closes.

options.label: Take the wedge
options.result: Ox practices bracing behind the wedge.

options.label: Take the kit
options.result: Wren uses the kit on the crew.

events.title: Exchange cache
events.text: A cache holds a purse and illustrated fighting instructions. The sender asks each visitor to leave one for the next crew.

options.label: Take the purse
options.result: The crew takes 30 gold and leaves the instructions.

options.label: Take the instructions
options.result: Kestrel studies the technique and leaves the purse.

events.title: One open corner
events.text: A model conceals a purse under one flap and a crowd-fighting diagram under another. Opening one seals the other.

options.label: Open the diagram flap
options.result: The crew learns a sweeping attack.

events.title: Under tension
events.text: A strip holds a door shut. Cut the upper strand to catch coins, or the lower one to catch bandages. The other bundle falls away.

story.intro: The swarm strips the fiber beds and feeds the stalks into a mill. Wren finds a damp sheet with a watermark shaped like an open hand. Ox holds the door while Kestrel pulls it free.

chapters.title: The harvest
chapters.text: The machines take living fiber as well as scraps. Wren treats a gardener with thread from her kit. The crew thinks the swarm is gathering stock for more bodies.

chapters.title: The mark
chapters.text: Every new sheet bears the same open hand. Kestrel finds it in the wire of a mould, not in ink. Ox keeps a sample dry. The mark looks less like a signature than a request.

chapters.title: The shipment
chapters.text: Drying racks fill with identical sheets. Each has room for a message, but none has one yet. The machines pack them for a print shop. The crew follows the paper and the mill that makes it.

story.bossIntro: The Total Collection lowers its screens over the vat. Its arms feed the pulp and mend the machinery around it. Wren spots the open-hand mould inside. Kestrel goes for the frame; Ox takes the first blow.
story.outro: The mill stops. One marked sheet escapes with the outgoing paper. Wren keeps a second sheet. The crew still expects to find a factory making swarm bodies.

creatures.name: Sort Thief
creatures.blurb: It steals individual sorts for the composing table.

creatures.name: Poster Flyby
creatures.blurb: A folded proof dives at anyone carrying a sheet.

creatures.name: Stamp Mites
creatures.blurb: They crowd moving parts with tiny engraved plates.

creatures.name: Grain Warden
creatures.blurb: It prints damp barriers over wounded machines.

creatures.name: Chapel Shift Bell
creatures.blurb: It rings for composing drones when a line remains unfinished.

creatures.name: Demonstration Mimic
creatures.blurb: It copies the crew’s movements with a press handle.

creatures.name: Archive Collator
creatures.blurb: Its interleaved sheets separate into smaller bundles when torn.

creatures.name: Specimen Caster
creatures.blurb: It sets solid blocks around itself before advancing.

creatures.name: Heritage Shell
creatures.blurb: It seals nearby presses in armor and protects itself behind a cover.

creatures.name: Festival Giant
creatures.blurb: Its broad wooden limbs clear space around the press.

creatures.name: Press Stitcher
creatures.blurb: It stitches torn belts and damaged machines back together.

creatures.name: Master Impression
creatures.blurb: It prints a single safe reply, shields its platen and calls machines to distribute the proofs.

creatures.name: Volunteer Printer
creatures.blurb: A printer uses a board to protect the crew.

creatures.name: Type Apprentice
creatures.blurb: An apprentice repairs equipment with spare type and wire.

events.title: Half a cycle
events.text: A press is stalled halfway down. A tool and pouch are on opposite sides. Only one can be pulled free before it drops.

options.label: Pull the tool
options.result: Kestrel practices breaking through a guard.

events.title: Two routes
events.text: Two guides disagree on the safe route. A printer offers a healing kit for checking both, or a purse for delivering one quickly.

options.label: Check both routes
options.result: The printer gives Wren a healing kit.

events.title: Folded route
events.text: A star book shows a sweeping maneuver on one face and a route to a cash box on another. Folding it one way hides the other.

events.title: Portable press
events.text: An outreach printer needs one bundle carried. One contains medical supplies for the crew; the other is a paid delivery. The printer can spare only one.

events.title: One different square
events.text: A misplaced repeat marks a box. Inside are a purse and a technique sheet. A note asks visitors to take one and leave one.

options.label: Take the technique
options.result: The crew learns how to jam a mechanism.

events.title: Test impression
events.text: A printer offers a medical roll or a guarding lesson for help testing two press settings. The other goes to an apprentice.

options.label: Accept the lesson
options.result: Ox learns a way to cover an ally.

story.intro: The marked paper reaches a print shop. Presses send out sheets covered in repeated impressions. Ox expects swarm orders. Wren checks the proofs instead.

chapters.title: Setting the line
chapters.text: The machines gather type and copy the open hand beside a short request: find us. Kestrel checks for a hidden command. There is none. Someone sent a plea before the swarm found the mould.

chapters.title: A reply made wrong
chapters.text: The swarm is trying to answer the plea by finding everyone it can. The presses keep replacing the request with a single reply: stay safe. Wren notices the reply leaves no room to say where anyone is.

chapters.title: The same answer
chapters.text: The swarm feeds corrected proofs back into the press until every copy agrees. Ox protects printers trying to save a different version. Kestrel finds the feed leading to the master press.

story.bossIntro: The Master Impression stacks wrong replies into a moving wall. It sends fresh copies out while its platen comes down. Kestrel works at a seam in the type. Ox keeps the press off Wren long enough to read the original.
story.outro: The press breaks. The original plea asks to be found, not put away. A bound proof has already gone onward. The swarm follows it, still trying to keep its promise.

creatures.name: Zine Maker

creatures.name: Collection Steward
creatures.blurb: A steward handles fragile people and pages with the same care.

events.title: Expiring drawer
events.text: A drawer is closing. A studio member asks the crew to save either a medical pouch or a book containing a defense lesson.

events.title: Before it drains
events.text: A sheet holds a technique while wet. A purse is sinking beside it. The drain is too fast to recover both.

options.label: Read the sheet
options.result: Wren learns a way to clear corruption.

events.title: Three maps
events.text: A printer offers either a first-aid tin or a lesson in disrupting machines for helping align three maps.

options.label: Take the lesson
options.result: The crew learns to jam a mechanism.

events.title: Half open
events.text: A pop-up landscape has a cash box under one hill and a healing kit under another. Closing one hill opens the other.

events.title: Out of order
events.text: A reading circle offers a purse or a defensive lesson for sorting a bundle. Its members need to keep the other for the next visitor.

options.label: Accept the purse
options.result: The circle gives the crew 40 gold.

options.label: Accept the lesson
options.result: The circle teaches the crew to cover an ally.

events.title: A bridge in a book
events.text: A proposal machine can build one model before its stock runs out. One demonstrates a wide strike; the other contains saleable brass fittings.

options.label: Build the brass model
options.result: The crew salvages fittings worth 45 gold.

options.label: Build the moving model
options.result: The crew studies the wide sweeping movement.

story.intro: The proof arrives among books that fold, open, and change shape. The swarm binds it into a new volume. Wren reads the original plea again. Someone wanted to be found; the book means to preserve everyone it finds.

chapters.title: Collected
chapters.text: The swarm makes copies of people and files the originals away. The shelves are orderly. Their occupants cannot leave. Ox holds a cabinet open while Wren helps someone out.

chapters.title: Different copies
chapters.text: Small presses pass around different versions of the plea. None is complete, but each reaches someone. Kestrel finds a seam in the swarm’s binding: it cannot fit conflicting pages into one perfect volume.

chapters.title: Leave a page open
chapters.text: The crew assembles the plea beside several possible replies. Wren adds a blank page for anyone still missing. The swarm insists on one finished answer. Its great bindery comes to collect the pages.

story.bossIntro: The Total Edition opens its armored covers. Feed arms pull at the pages while smaller machines gather the crew. Ox braces the stack. Kestrel prises the spine apart, and Wren holds the blank page out of reach.
story.outro: The bindery falls open. The crew frees the people inside and leaves the plea where others can add an answer. The swarm wanted to keep everyone safe by preserving them unchanged. The open book gives the missing a way to be found without being shut away.
